messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: 1855554321 - High tail latency observed on /v1/generate for dedicated pool 'eu-west-dedicated'. p95 token latency > 5s. Auto-fallback to human-in-the-loop triggered for flagged requests. Paging oncall.

Maya Chen: Oncall here, acknowledged. Confirming: we tripped the token-throttle threshold and the routing policy started sending flagged long-form jobs to HIL. Current impact: a subset of customer flows delayed, some failed requests reverted to 429 before fallback engaged. I'll summarize state and handoff plan below. :wave:

Samir Patel: Reading metrics now. We briefly saturated 2 nodes due to concurrent long-context streams. I scaled the pool +4 GPUs (fast path) at ~1855554400, that brought capacity up but autoscaler lagged. Enabled routing to redwood-medium variant for non-critical traffic at 1855554520 to shed load.

Jon Wallace: Logs show a surge of large-prefix chat requests from one partner account (acct: partner-zenith) — roughly 40% of token pressure. I flagged a rate-limit config for that customer and opened a ticket to their support. Link to service account activity: https://redwood-internal/logs/streams/partner-zenith (internal)

Maya Chen: Quick state: primary mitigation done (scale + fallback). Current errors: 429 spike down from 18% -> 3% in last 10m. HIL queue length ~ 12 (normal window 0-2). HIL team paged for manual review on top-3 items. No full customer outage, some increased latency and a handful of degraded completions.

incident-bot: Pager created: INC-2026-1855 - Dedicated pool capacity surge -> human fallbacks enabled. Jira: REDW-INC-1855. oncall-bot assigned incident to Maya Chen (primary) and Samir Patel (secondary).

Tasha Lee: Heads-up — APAC autoscaler policy still uses 5m cooldown; when we scale it keeps undershooting during these bursts. That's a coverage gap for night shifts. Recommend we add a short-term manual scale for apac and follow-up with policy tweak. I can schedule a PR to shorten cooldown to 90s tomorrow.

Ravi Kumar: I'll take overlap coverage for APAC on the next shift. @Maya when you hand off please call out the APAC manual scale step and the HIL queue status. Also, which runbook did we use for the HIL flow? I want the exact play.

Maya Chen: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/human-fallback - follow section "surge containment". Quick commands I ran:
```
# check h IL queue
rctl h il-q status --env prod
# scale pool
rctl pool scale --pool eu-west-dedicated --add-gpus 4
# route policy
rctl route update --policy long-gen --fallback redwood-medium
```

Jon Wallace: Added tip: if you need to temporarily block partner-zenith while we work with them:
```
rctl acct throttle --acct partner-zenith --rate 5r/s
```
That immediately reduced token pressure in my test.

Samir Patel: Next steps I left in the incident ticket: 1) monitor hIL queue until <3, 2) watch p95 token latency, 3) coordinate with GTM for partner rate change if they want to resume. I've pinned the relevant dashboards on the incident ticket.

Maya Chen: Handoff checklist for next shift (short):
- Primary: Ravi Kumar (take ownership of INC-2026-1855)
- Secondary: Samir Patel
- Coverage gap: APAC autoscaler cooldown — manual scale instruction in runbook, Tasha PR pending for cooldown change
- Key dashboards: /dashboards/infra/p95-token-latency, /dashboards/hil/queue-length
- Customer contacts: partner-zenith@acct, support ticket REDW-4356
- Escalation: if p95 > 6s or HIL queue > 20, escalate to oncall-sre and page infra-leads

Ravi Kumar: Got it, taking primary at 1855557600 local. I'll perform a manual scale in APAC at start of shift to stabilize and then revert to autoscaler. Please drop me the HIL review link and any example prompts causing flags.

Maya Chen: HIL review queue: https://redwood-internal/hil/queues/prod/top. Example flagged prompt IDs pinned to the ticket under "samples". Also note: we suppressed automated re-runs to prevent duplicate charges — manual review only for now.

Tasha Lee: I'll follow up on the PR to shorten cooldown. Leaving a note: change needs small perf test — I'll coordinate with infra tomorrow morning 09:30 PT.

Samir Patel: Small ops note: I left a temporary rate-limit rule for partner-zenith that will auto-remove in 2h. If the partner needs to resume earlier, ping me and we'll adjust.

Maya Chen: Final summary: incident mitigated to low impact, key mitigations applied (manual scale, routing fallback, partner throttle, HIL engagement). Primary/secondary assigned for next shift (Ravi/Samir). Runbook link and commands above. I'll hand off now — flag me if anything spikes. :handshake:

Ravi Kumar: Acknowledged. I'll pick this up and post a short update at +30m into shift. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Ravi Kumar, secondary=Samir Patel, incident=REDW-INC-1855, handoff_ts=1855557890

Maya Chen: signing off for morning, leaving Slack watch to Ravi. :coffee:
